itemUsage.en: Titi, 'Honorary Minoan' and current curator of Sargon's Varjavandabad Museum, soon to be adding more titles to her resume.
itemUsage.zh: “荣誉米诺斯人”，萨尔贡法尔贾万达巴德博物馆现任馆长缇缇，她的头衔可能还会再加长。

itemDesc.en: She's ready to start a new heroic epic together.
itemDesc.zh: 她已做好准备，与你一同走入一段全新的英雄故事。

description.en:
<@ba.vdown>Stops attacking</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, and puts herself and the Operator within Attack Range with the lowest HP percentage to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> until the skill ends; continuously puts enemies around herself and the target to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</>; Talent 1 effect increases to <@ba.vup>{talent_scale}</>x
<@ba.rem>Can manually deactivate skill at any time</>
description.zh: <@ba.vdown>停止攻击</>，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，技能开启时使自身与攻击范围内生命比例最低的干员陷入<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>直到技能结束，期间持续使自身与该目标周围的敌人陷入<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>，第一天赋效果提升至<@ba.vup>{talent_scale}</>倍\n<@ba.rem>可主动关闭技能（期间可随时停止技能）</>

description.en: ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, attacks 2 enemies simultaneously, and attacking targets that are not <$ba.sleep>Asleep</> puts them to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for <@ba.vup>{attack@sleep}</>s; all enemies awakening from <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> or defeated during <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> receive Arts damage (damage based on <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> duration, up to <@ba.vup>{max_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK), and put one other nearby enemy to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for <@ba.vup>{sleep}</>s; when other allied Operators within Attack Range receive lethal damage, they are instead put to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> until fully healed or skill ends
description.zh: 攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，同时攻击两名敌人，攻击非<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>目标时使其<$ba.sleep>沉睡</><@ba.vup>{attack@sleep}</>秒，技能期间，全场敌人从<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>状态醒来或于<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>中被击倒时，受到法术伤害（随<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>时长提高至攻击力<@ba.vup>{max_atk_scale:0%}</>），并使周围一名其他敌人<$ba.sleep>沉睡</><@ba.vup>{sleep}</>秒，攻击范围内的其他友方干员受到致命伤害时，陷入<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>至生命值完全恢复或技能结束

description.en: Returning to Menat-Ha'mait from Trimounts takes at least three months. She could hitchhike with mercenary caravans in Columbia, but the journey home got harder once outside the country. Only after wasting several days at a border town does she finally find a caravan headed the right way back. Titi makes friends with the caravan leader in just a few days, a dark-skinned Liberi called Inam. She is quite curious about Titi's solo journey, as well as her past experiences. 'A Sargonian going to Columbia to study is rare enough, but for such a niche major? And now you're even headed home? Why?' 'Well, I did get scouted by a few Columbian museums after I graduated, but... I still feel 'Sargonian'. Besides, all my best friends are back home.' 'But you haven't seen them in years, have you?' 'We grew up together. We would play pranks on each other, but also help each other sneak out to play. They've kept in touch with me during my time in Columbia too. I know Pepe's an archaeologist now, leading a dig in the south, while Anat's life has probably been arranged by her father, but I'm sure she'll break free from that and do what she really wants—she's always talked about traveling the land and seeing what's outside Sargon.' 'So everyone has a goal in mind.' 'Well, they do. As for me, my family likes to say my heart's as fickle as the sands, easily swayed by a gust of wind. I went to study in Columbia on a whim, but to be honest...' Titi can still remember the night of her father's funeral. Her mother went to rest once all the guests were gone, leaving her alone in her father's study. The chair he used to occupy was now empty, and she realized for the first time how scary the bookshelves she used to take lightly were. Every shelf was crammed with tomes, as if they could burst free at any moment and crash down on her bewildered self. At that moment, she heard a familiar knocking sound from the window. A secret code used with her friends. Then, Pepe nimbly opened the window and climbed into the study with Anat in tow. With a surprised expression, Titi recalled her mother bidding farewell to them earlier, along with their parents. 'Titi... you didn't eat much earlier, did you? We got you some food.' Anat took out two pieces of sun bread, handing one each to Titi and Pepe. 'You have one too.' The sun bread was filled with Titi's favorite orange flavor, and reminded her of her empty stomach. When she finally took her first bite, Pepe seemed to heave a sigh of relief, and took a bite from her own as well, although she immediately grimaced. 'Anat, you jerk! What did you stuff into mine?!' Anat smiled shyly. The two began to squabble with exaggerated, almost theatrical movements. Titi could see they were clearly acting it out. Amidst their laughter and playful antics, a warmth seeped back into the study. 'I think... I can help them realize their own dreams first. Then I'll figure out what I want to do myself.'
description.zh:
从特里蒙回米纳特哈玛仪，至少也要三个月。在哥伦比亚时还好，可以蹭雇佣兵团的车队，但之后就很麻烦。在边境小镇滞留了五六天后，缇缇才终于遇上了合适的商队。
没几天，缇缇就与商队的队长交上了朋友。那是位深色皮肤的黎博利，自称依娜姆。对于缇缇孤身上路的事，还有缇缇从前的经历，她显然很是好奇。
“萨尔贡人去哥伦比亚留学就很难得了，学这么冷门的专业，读完后又要回萨尔贡，为什么呢？”
“唔，毕业后确实有些哥伦比亚博物馆向我提出了邀约，但总感觉……自己还是属于萨尔贡的。而且，我最好的朋友都还在这里呀。”
“但你们已经有四五年没见面了吧？”
“我们从小一起长大，会互相恶作剧，还会给对方打掩护偷溜出门玩。而且，就算是我在哥伦比亚的时候，我们也保持着通信。我知道佩佩现在成了考古学家，正在南方主持现场发掘。还有阿娜特，她的父亲应该替她安排好了一切，但我相信，她一定会摆脱束缚，去做她真正想做的事——她一直想去旅行，去外面看看。”
“大家都有很坚定的目标呢。”
“那是她们啦，我嘛，家里人常说我的心像沙丘，有风吹过就会变化，去哥伦比亚留学也是突然跳出来的点子。不过，真要说的话……”
缇缇还能清晰地记起父亲葬礼的那个夜晚。送走所有客人之后，母亲去休息了，只有她一个人留在父亲的书房里。父亲常坐的椅子上空荡荡的。她第一次发现，原本习以为常的书架竟然如此可怕，每一个格子都塞满书卷，似乎随时都会坍塌，向着茫然站在屋子正中的她倒下。
也正是在这时候，窗上传来了熟悉的敲击声，这是她和朋友们之间的暗码。
而后，佩佩轻车熟路地拉开窗子，爬进书房，还拉了把等在外面的阿娜特。明明就在不久前，母亲已将她俩和她们的家长送走了……缇缇惊讶地看着两人。
“缇缇……刚才都没吃什么东西吧？我们来给你送吃的。”阿娜特拿出了两个太阳饼，分别递给了缇缇和佩佩，“佩佩也吃。”
太阳饼里夹着缇缇最喜欢的橘子馅，香甜的气息让她在这时候才意识到自己确实饿了。而当她终于咬下第一口，面前的佩佩似乎放心了，也咬了一口手里的饼，而后立刻做出龇牙咧嘴的表情。
“阿娜特！你这家伙！往我的饼里夹了什么！”
阿娜特羞怯地笑了。两人随后便打闹起来，动作非常夸张，带着一些表演的成分，缇缇知道，她们是故意的。在她们的笑闹声中，书房似乎又恢复了往日的温暖。
“我想，我可以先去帮她们完成她们的心愿，然后……我也会找到我自己的目标。”
